entities.summary: Wesley University, formerly known as Wesley University of Science and Technology (WUSTO), is a private Christian University located in Ondo City, Ondo State, Nigeria. It was established in 2007 by the Methodist Church Nigeria and is licensed by the National Universities Commission (NUC) to operate as a degree-awarding institution.
